comment: The boot program this unit starts from. A name, a length and four digests are measurements of a file rather than any part of it, and a digest reconstructs nothing. The program itself is not carried here, is not downloaded, and is not reconstructible from anything in this repository.
decides: sha256 decides. The size rejects a wrong file for one stat call, and crc32, md5 and sha1 are published beside it so a copy can be cross-checked against a catalogue that keys on any of them. None of those three decides anything on its own: crc32 is a 32-bit error code, and md5 and sha1 are both collision-broken.

artifacts.name: SPC700 boot program
artifacts.why: Sixty four bytes Sony put in the audio unit. It is what runs at power on: it answers the console's handshake, takes a block of code over the four ports, and jumps into it.
artifacts.canonical: The sixty four bytes as the unit reads them at 0xFFC0 through 0xFFFF, with nothing stripped and nothing prepended.

provenance.from: A copy already on this machine, measured on 2026-08-26. The same sixty four bytes are carried in the open source of more than one emulator, so a reader can confirm the digests without owning a console.
